title: School therapy staffing — evidence-linked requirements pack
status: Research and proposed specification; no live staffing service or integrations implemented

scope.worked_example: Speech-language pathology staffing for a school district; OT and PT variants must be configured separately
scope.discipline_status: SLP is a planning example, not a user-selected exclusion of OT or PT
scope.jurisdiction: United States baseline research; state not selected
scope.delivery_model: Staffing-first example. District-approved modality; in-person, virtual and hybrid eligibility are not assumed interchangeable.
scope.commercial_model: Agency supplies qualified therapists to district-approved assignments. Employment model, direct-versus-subcontract route and executed commercial terms remain undecided.
scope.clinical_boundary: Qualified professionals and the authorized school team own evaluation, eligibility, service plans, therapy delivery, clinical attestations and decisions about missed services. Agents support administration.
scope.student_data_boundary: Keep student clinical and IEP content in the district-designated system for the initial design. Use permitted opaque references and minimum approved aggregates only; an opaque reference can still be protected education data.
out_of_scope: Independent changes to IEP obligations or automatic compensatory-service decisions
An asserted complete reconstruction of Amergis internal systems

design_principles: Separate published observations, source-specific contractual rules, proposed system behavior and unresolved requirements.
Maintain one authoritative record owner per object; preserve external identifiers and original evidence.
Keep approved service obligations, scheduled work, actual services, worked time and billable amounts distinct.
Treat workload as direct and indirect duties, not a universal number of students or therapy minutes.
Bind consequential approvals to the exact action payload and relevant record/policy versions.
All candidate, district and student fixtures are synthetic. No actual students, applicants or private records were accessed.

School terms, holidays, closures, recurring availability, cross-site travel and approved workload constraints.

discovery_sessions.audience: District special education director and procurement
questions: Walk through the last therapy staffing request from vacancy to approved start.
Which services, documentation and response commitments are mandatory, and who approves exceptions?
Which systems, provider levels and modalities must vendors use?
Show a redacted accepted and rejected invoice or submission; what changed the outcome?
discovery_sessions.status: Guide prepared; no outreach or interviews performed

questions: Walk through a normal week and a disrupted week, including paperwork, meetings, travel and supervision.
What does onboarding require before you may work at a particular school?
How do you record work and service delivery, and correct mistakes?
Which proposed automations would you want to inspect or approve?
discovery_sessions.status: Guide prepared; voluntary participation and permitted redacted examples needed

questions: What makes a provider ready for one school but not another?
Which documents or matches require manual interpretation?
Where do duplicates, delays and failed handoffs occur?
Who can approve a substitute, supervised provider or changed assignment?
What determines worked time, payable treatment and invoice units?
What happens after a disputed invoice, closure, late approval or retroactive correction?
Show the required export, acknowledgments and release approvals using synthetic or redacted records.
When are workers paid versus customer cash received, and how is the gap funded?

economics.status: Input specification only; no observed economics, vendor quotes or revenue forecast

inputs.name: Billable units and rate by activity

inputs.name: Provider paid hours and rate
inputs.unit: hours / USD per hour or selected pay basis
inputs.source_needed: Actual employment/pay agreement and applicable rule review

inputs.name: Employer burden and insurance allocation
inputs.unit: USD per period or approved cost basis

inputs.name: Recruitment and customer acquisition cost
inputs.source_needed: Observed permitted acquisition funnel and campaign spend

inputs.name: Unbilled work, school closures and paid leave
inputs.source_needed: Contract, employment terms and actual calendar

inputs.name: Software, integration and transaction charges
inputs.source_needed: Current vendor quotes including API and minimum commitments

inputs.name: Administrative and exception handling
inputs.unit: minutes per case / USD per hour
inputs.source_needed: Observed work sampling, including human oversight

inputs.name: Payroll outflow and customer collection dates
inputs.source_needed: Pay schedule, billing acceptance and actual payment history

formulas: Contribution for a period = earned customer revenue less provider compensation, employer burden, variable delivery costs and allocated variable operating effort. This is not net profit.
Projected cash at date t = opening cash + cumulative collected receipts through t - cumulative paid outflows through t. Funding need is the greatest deficit plus an owner-selected reserve.
Cost per filled assignment = consistently scoped acquisition, onboarding and delivery costs / completed qualifying assignments. Define period and exclusions before comparison.
Do not substitute public contract ceilings for negotiated revenue, advertised pay for total employment cost, or service minutes for all worked time.
